runner.input_policy: explicit frozen paths and hashes only; no model, dataset, checkpoint, or latest-artifact discovery
runner.output_policy: append-only terminal row schema with Whether-A, Whether-B, Where, status, failure code, and runtime metadata
runner.gt_policy: model-facing runner contract accepts no ground-truth payload

test.scope: synthetic-only registry, hash-gate, output, failure-propagation, adjudication, mechanism-blocker, and V3 coverage tests

note: This implementation manifest supplements rather than modifies frozen V2. It cannot authorize inference.
